name: release-packaging
//: The native release-packaging journeys: scripts/release-packages.sh, scripts/release-verify.sh and scripts/install.sh driven with the real compiler, maturin and pip, and on an Apple Silicon Mac release.yml's darwin job (scripts/release-darwin.sh, its staging and upload steps). Its own project because it drives real host tools for minutes, so no edit to the offline release-targets suite pays for it. Edges: llmlint is the crate it builds, repo-tooling owns the scripts it runs, ci-workflows owns the release.yml steps it runs.

packaging.//: Outside the gate tiers: a release build, a maturin wheel and a pip install for the host target, plus the Darwin release job on Apple Silicon. Run with `just test-packaging`; CI's macos lane runs it.
